clause.text: The skills in **clusters**, by the words their *names* share, split at `-`, `_`, `.` and spaces, in any case: the word the most skills share makes the first cluster, with every skill that has it

scenes.caption: build is in the most names, so it is first, with every skill that has it: gradle-build too

clause.text: then the same among the skills left, while a word is shared by two of them

scenes.caption: gradle-build is taken: of the skills left, only gradle-bump has gradle, so gradle is no cluster

clause.text: a tie → the word first in the alphabet

scenes.caption: java, kotlin, lint and test are each in 2 names: java, first in the alphabet, takes java-lint and java-test
commits and gradle-bump share no word left: Other, last

clause.text: Each cluster under a heading, `<word> · N`, largest first, its skills by name
